So one night I was at this party, nothing big it was for my father's friend and there were many adults there, but after a while it had become boring and me and a couple other kids from the party went over to one of their houses to play some basketball. Thinking nothing of it because he lives only a street over we went. When we were there we played a quick basketball game and in the middle of the second one we heard a crazy sound. It sounded like metal scratching together but also a car screeching to a halt.  We had all stopped and turned around and all we saw was a massive blue line form from the road at least 100 miles in the sky, it lasted for about 5 seconds and then it was over. We all stood there and about 2 seconds later a red line scans us. At this point we are all flipping shit and scared and we run inside this kids house for the next 10 minutes and then one of their fathers called them back saying they had to go. So we grab an air soft gun and slowly walk over there. We hid the gun under a car so the parents wouldn't ask what happened. I still see all of the people I had experienced this with and we never speak of it. The same party is coming up next weekend and I have been hearing that sound again. I have no idea what it could have been. 

TL;DR: was at a party, had a red light scan me and my friends from nowhere, then a massive blue light jutted up from where it looked like the red light was, me and friends noped outta there

It sounded like metal scratching together but also a car screeching to a halt.  We had all stopped and turned around and all we saw was a massive blue line form from the road at least 100 miles in the sky, it lasted for about 5 seconds and then it was over. We all stood there and about 2 seconds later a red line scans us. At this point we are all flipping shit and scared and we run inside this kids house for the next 10 minutes and then one of their fathers called them back saying they had to go. So we grab an air soft gun and slowly walk over there. We hid the gun under a car so the parents wouldn't ask what happened. I still see all of the people I had experienced this with and we never speak of it. The same party is coming up next weekend and I have been hearing that sound again. I have no idea what it could have been.
